name: The I.T. Bear Guardian
author: theitbear

sections.description:
The I.T. Bear Guardian slows scrapers and bots that rush through the site. Real customers can still browse, book, and pay. WordPress admin and the login stay open.

This WordPress.org copy uses one mode: Safety Lite. It warns, then blocks, when a visitor hits 12 different pages in 3 minutes.

What you get

  • Safety Lite on pages, posts, and the home page
  • Google and Bing’s own crawlers stay allowed
  • Named bots you can turn off (they start allowed)
  • A block list you can release from, plus an audit log
  • Block emails to an address you set (or the site admin)
  • Optional country name on a block (off until you turn Look up the country on — see External services)
  • No Bear Cave account needed for this copy

Protect Contact

Hide your email, phone, or WhatsApp behind a click-to-reveal control. Paste a shortcode where the plain contact used to sit. Match page, text link, outline, and solid are included. Soft catch can stop more reveals when something acts like a machine.

Bear Guardian (Premium)

Bear Guardian is a separate plugin. This download does not install it. Open Go Premium in the menu to see what it adds, or Upgrade from there.

Premium adds stricter modes (Police State, FBI, Custom), whitelisted addresses, a page group with its own rule, country blocks, named AI crawlers with a host check, timed blocks, and Protect Contact styles (soft, pill, chip, fonts, colours, Alt look, and Hard catch).

External services

The I.T. Bear Guardian can look up the country of a blocked address. That lookup stays off until you tick Look up the country on The I.T. Bear Guardian screen and press Save.

When it is on, and an address is blocked, the plugin sends that address to ipwho.is. ipwho.is is run by ipwhois.io. The reply is the country name, which is shown on the block list and in the block email. No other data is sent. The lookup does not run for an address that is not blocked, and it does not run while the box is unticked.

This service is provided by ipwhois.io: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add Plugin, search for The I.T. Bear Guardian, and install it. Or upload the zip under Plugins → Add Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open The I.T. Bear Guardian in the left menu and press Active to turn Safety Lite on.
  4. Optional: set the block email, turn named bots off as you need, and turn on Look up the country only if you want country names on blocks.
  5. Optional: open Protect Contact, add an email, phone, or WhatsApp, choose a look, Save, then paste a shortcode such as [tib_show type="email"] on a page.
  6. To see what Premium adds, open Go Premium. Upgrade opens the Bear Guardian page on The I.T. Bear site. Premium is a separate plugin install, not an in-place upgrade of this one.
sections.faq:
What problem does this plugin solve?

AI bots and scrapers can race through a business website in a few minutes. They copy your pages, services, prices, and wording. They also pull images and other digital assets (photos of the work, logos, downloadable files linked from the site). That material is your intellectual property (IP). Competitors — or people selling data to competitors — can reuse it, feed it into their own AI tools, and undercut you. The same rush often grabs email and phone numbers for spam. The I.T. Bear Guardian slows that rush on public pages, then blocks the address when it trips the limit. Real customers can still browse, book, and pay. WordPress admin and the login stay open. Google and Bing’s own crawlers stay allowed.

How does it protect my IP from competitors and AI bots?

Your IP here is the business content and assets on the site: copy, offers, images, and how you describe what you sell. A bot that opens many different pages in a short time can steal that wholesale. Safety Lite warns, then blocks, when a visitor hits 12 different pages in 3 minutes (that window is minutes, not seconds), so a scrape cannot finish quietly. You can also turn named bots off. That does not stop every human from reading a page — it stops the automated sweep that copies the site for reuse or resale. Premium modes are stricter (shorter windows in seconds) for sites that need a tighter limit — see Go Premium.

Will this reduce spam emails and sales pitches?

It helps in two ways. First, the bot stopper (Safety Lite and named-bot controls) blocks addresses that rush the site — the same pattern scrapers use before they harvest contacts and send “we can rank you” spam. Second, Protect Contact hides email, phone, or WhatsApp behind a click-to-reveal control, so a bot that only reads the HTML does not get the detail. Use both for best cover. Soft catch on Protect Contact can stop more reveals when something acts like a machine. Premium adds Hard catch and richer Protect Contact looks.

Does this lock me out of wp-admin?

No. WordPress admin and the login page stay open. Developers can still work in wp-admin. Customers can still use the public site.

What does Safety Lite do?

Safety Lite is the bot stopper in this WordPress.org copy. It warns, then blocks, when a visitor hits 12 different pages in 3 minutes. That is a three-minute window, not three seconds. Blocked addresses go on your list so you can release them. Google and Bing’s own crawlers stay allowed. Police State, FBI, and Custom are stricter Premium modes (tighter counts and shorter windows, including limits measured in seconds) in Bear Guardian, a separate plugin.

Can I stop AI bots and scrapers by name?

Yes, on this zip: turn a named bot off and a visit that sends that name is refused. Safety Lite still covers rush traffic that does not use a known name. Premium adds named AI crawlers with a host check and stricter modes (see Go Premium).

What happens to a blocked IP address?

The visitor’s address goes on your block list. You can release it. Optional: turn on Look up the country so a blocked address can show a country name (off until you opt in — see External services). Premium can add timed blocks, country blocks, and whitelisted addresses (office, your own connection) that stay allowed.

How do I hide my email or phone from scrapers?

Use Protect Contact as well as the bot stopper. Add an email, phone, or WhatsApp, choose a look (Match page, text link, outline, or solid), Save, then paste a shortcode such as [tib_show type=”email”] where the plain contact used to sit. Soft catch is included. Soft, pill, chip, fonts, colours, Alt look, and Hard catch are in Bear Guardian Premium.

Why upgrade to a Premium licence?

Premium is Bear Guardian (a separate plugin), not an in-place upgrade of this zip. It adds stricter bot-stopper modes (Police State, FBI, Custom), whitelisted addresses, a page group with its own rule, country blocks, named AI crawlers with a host check, timed blocks, and richer Protect Contact styles (soft, pill, chip, fonts, colours, Alt look, and Hard catch). Open Go Premium in the menu for the list, then Upgrade on the Bear Guardian page on The I.T. Bear site. Creating a Bear Cave account is free; Premium is the paid licence when you want those extras.

Is this the same as Bear Guardian Premium?

No. This download is The I.T. Bear Guardian on WordPress.org (Safety Lite bot stopper + free Protect Contact looks). Bear Guardian is the separate Cave plugin that carries Premium. This zip does not install Premium for you.

Do I need a Bear Cave account for this WordPress.org copy?

No. This copy runs Safety Lite with no Bear Cave account. If you later want Premium, you can create a Bear Cave account for free, then buy or take the right licence there. Country lookup on this zip stays off until you turn it on.

Does this replace Wordfence or a login lockout plugin?

No. It does not lock out login guesses or scan files for malware. Those jobs stay with a login-security plugin. Both can be on. This plugin’s job is rush scrapers, AI bots on public pages, and contact harvesting.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Protect Contact. Click to reveal email, phone, or WhatsApp. Match page, text link, outline, and solid. Soft catch is included.
  • Soft, pill, chip, fonts, colours, Alt look, and Hard catch stay in Bear Guardian Premium. Go Premium describes them and links to Upgrade.
  • Clearer Description and Installation on the WordPress.org listing.

1.0.2

  • Named bots are free. Turning one off refuses a visit that sends that name.
  • Blocked addresses shows Blocks, filters, pages, and a closed audit log.
  • Mail field for block emails. Blank uses the site admin email.
  • Admin notices sit under the header.

1.0.1

  • The readme names this download as The I.T. Bear Guardian. Bear Guardian is a separate plugin.
  • Styles and the Pages script load through WordPress.
  • Country lookup stays off until it is turned on. The readme names ipwho.is.

1.0.0

  • Safety Lite for WordPress.org.
